label: Lessonspace
description: Manage lesson spaces, sessions, participants and recordings

operations.name: list_sessions
operations.description: Fetch the sessions for an organisation.

operations.name: get_session
operations.description: Fetch a session with the given UUID.

operations.name: update_session
operations.description: Update a session's name or recording access policy for the given UUID.

operations.name: delete_session_recordings
operations.description:
Irreversible: Delete all recording data associated with a specific session, including AV, events and transcriptions.

This cannot be undone. If the space stores recordings in a customer-owned (custom) bucket, the request is rejected and nothing is deleted unless `force_delete_custom_buckets` is set. Basic session metadata such as name and participants is retained and stays visible in the sessions list. Related spaces are not affected by this deletion and can continue to be used for new sessions.

operations.name: get_session_transcript
operations.description: Fetch the transcription for a given session. The transcription must have been scheduled on the session beforehand.

operations.name: delete_space_recordings
operations.description:
Irreversible: Delete all recording data for every session that has happened inside a space, including AV, events and transcriptions. The space itself is not deleted and remains usable.

This cannot be undone. If the space stores recordings in a customer-owned (custom) bucket, the request is rejected and nothing is deleted unless `force_delete_custom_buckets` is set. Basic session metadata such as name and participants is retained and stays visible in the sessions list. Related spaces are not affected by this deletion and can continue to be used for new sessions.

operations.name: list_space_sessions
operations.description: Fetch the sessions for a specific space.
